name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Shinjuku Chuuou Kouen Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 新宿中央公園殺人事件
source:
Police inspector Scott Kingsley has asked Jake Hunter for help when a young woman was found dead in Aspicio Central Park. Jake accepts the case, but first he needs to find witnesses that are willing to speak out.
